correctness.rationale: With constant absorbing zero 0, every member is a map f(0)=0 and f³(x)=0. A commutative S is a clique in the full commuting graph of such maps; every clique lies in a maximal clique. The inspected exact integer verify.py enumerates all cube-zero maps, edges and maximal cliques and tests nonnull products and equality of extremal cliques with explicit families N∪F. Independently rebuilt the same search for n4..6 and separately performed a full independently implemented n7 maximal-clique census: 6607 cube-zero maps, 375996 edges, 138662 maximal cliques, exactly 360 nonnull extremal cliques per fixed zero of size36, matching every constructed family. Smaller maxima 3,6,12, so global sizes 3,6,12,36; n-fold labels 24,120,1080,2520. Nonconstant zero is ruled out by invariant-fiber injection and strict smaller-fiber bounds from the established unrestricted nilpotent maxima. The computer enumeration is exhaustive at these fixed sizes, not a theorem for all n.
